description:
Full pre-trade risk scan JSON for a stock. Pro tool ($0.15/call via x402
    for anonymous callers; Credits for signed-in accounts).

    Signed-in hpsilab users (including Free, on its trial Credits) spend
    Credits from their balance at this tool's catalog price — each tool is
    priced differently; see GET /api/credits/catalog.
    Anonymous / tokenless agents pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base) when
    payments are enabled — send the x402 payment in the request _meta.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol, e.g. "NVDA".
name: get_pretrade_risk_scan
title: Pre-Trade Risk Scan
